newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up ahead of USDA data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up ahead of USDA data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended firmer in active trading, extending late Monday's gains on speculation that soyoil will gain further on forecast of bullish USDA's report. May futures was trading above the 1,250 ringgit level and the uptrend is seen intact. Next resistance is pegged at 1,265 and then 1,280.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed futures, but gains seen capped by lack of demand and higher output.

Technically, the market is trading above the psychological level of 1,250 (May futures) and we believe that the upside potential is still intact," a trader said. "The market is trying the next resistance of 1,265 and then 1,280."
"This again depends a lot on the performance of the soyoil tonight after the UDSA report."
At the close, May futures contract was up 12 ringgit at 1,255 ringgit ($507.07) a tonne.
Traders said prices were likely to remain rangebound as players waited for fresh estimates of February crop later this week.
Lack of fresh export business and speculation of higher production could prompt some selling at the higher levels, traders said.

Among physicals, Mar (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,302.50 ringgit against bids of 1,297.50 after trading from 1,290 to 1,300. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,290 against bids of 1,282.50 with earlier trades done at 1,280 and 1282.50.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,295 with bids at 1,287.50, with early transactions from 1,282.50 to 1,290. Apr (central) saw offers at 1,285 with bids at 1,275 with early deals at 1,277.50 and 1,280.
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $557.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Apr at $552.50 and May/Jun at $545. Mar was traded at $554 and $555.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $587.50, Apr at $582.50 May/Jun at $575. Mar was dealt at $584 and $585.
Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $457.50 and Mar/Apr palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $310.
